description: MiniMax H3 FL2VA int8 transformer with a refusal-reduced (abliterated) Heretic Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder, plus the official video and audio VAEs and the RealESRGAN x2 upscaler, as published by drowzeys. The text encoder is abliterated (refusal-reduced: Heretic ARA on attention output layers 31-40; upstream reports 4/100 refusals against 99/100 for the stock encoder); the video model (transformer and VAEs) is stock MiniMax H3 from Comfy-Org. The underlying MiniMax H3 Community License applies; the encoder is Apache-2.0 and the upscaler BSD-3-Clause.
